text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — dashboard sampling for auth-routing metrics is masking spikes from orphaned service accounts. Underreported quota runs in prod :thinking_face:
Jamal Ortiz: Yeah, noticed a discrepancy yesterday when tracing a quota alert. Uniform sampling is hiding small-but-high-impact tails.
Eric Park: We picked uniform to keep ingestion predictable. Stratified would be better for coverage but costs more.
Tina Li: Can we at least surface a raw counter for quota breach signals (low-cardinality) and keep sampled traces for detail?
Anjali Rao: We can. Proposal: keep a lightweight counter stream for SLO triggers + stratified sampling for trace/event payloads. Minimizes overhead but keeps alert fidelity.
Jamal Ortiz: Sample config sketch:```json
{
  "sampling": "stratified",
  "buckets_by": ["org_id","project_id","sa_id"],
  "rate_per_bucket": 0.01,
  "min_events_per_bucket": 5
}
```
Maria Chen: Would a change like that break existing dashboard historical continuity? PM is worried about churn in the auth routing graphs.
Eric Park: We should version the sampling schema and emit both v1(v=uniform) and v2(stratified) metrics during rollout. That way dashboards can opt into v2 while keeping v1 for baseline. Also need to capture when auth-proxy rewrites origin — we currently lose attribution.
Tina Li: Can we put the sampling toggle in Console under Observability -> Auth Routing? PM wants a canary UI to flip for regions.
Jamal Ortiz: @Anjali can you estimate delta on event ingestion if we stratify by org+project+sa? Also ensure we never log sa.display_name or other PII.
Anjali Rao: Quick estimate: naive stratification would increase event count ~+60%, but with prefix hashing and dropping large payloads we can get it down to ~+25%. PII: we only include ids, no display names. Will add HMAC-on-id option for extra safety.
Maria Chen: OK. Canary plan suggestion: rollout flag "auth-sampling-stratified" scoped to us-east-1: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over one week, with a 48h hold at 25% to compare dashboards + billing.
Eric Park: I'll draft a rollout runbook. Include these quick fail criteria: ingest delta > +40% for 6h, backlog growth > 10m events, or alert rate increase without matching raw counter increase.
Tina Li: Also add a console guardrail: if sampling-v2 is enabled, surface a banner on affected dashboards: "Sampling mode: stratified (v2) — metrics may differ from previous period" :warning:
Jamal Ortiz: One more: ensure quota throttles still use raw counters (not sampled). We can't make throttle decisions on sampled views.
Anjali Rao: Confirmed — throttles use the raw SLO counter stream we discussed.
auth-bot: Feature flag "auth-sampling-stratified" created by Eric Park. Canary started at 2026-03-21T14:12:10Z for channel us-east-1 (5%). :rocket:
Maria Chen: Great. Please link the runbook and add the dashboard comparisons in the canary ticket. I'll coordinate with PM for messaging. :eyes:
